name: nophysics
title: No Box2D: Tombola sequencer and hidden Lander game removed
status_note: image-verified (bench checks every patched byte) + static reachability proof (prove.py); not yet run on the device
summary: Takes TE's Box2D physics library out of the firmware together with its only two users: the Tombola sequencer and the hidden Lander game. Picking Tombola (or a saved Tombola setting) gives the pattern sequencer, the Lander key combination does nothing. Nothing builds a physics world at boot any more (TE built two, for Tombola and Lander, whether used or not), lander.svg (171 KB) and tombola.svg are no longer parsed at boot, and 145 KB of TE code (Box2D 115 KB + dead Lander / Tombola code) is overwritten with RTS: free for later SDK code. No C code: the 36 code pointers that led into the removed code now lead to the first RTS of the blanked Box2D range.
